purpose: Breadth: across plausible provider shapes, how many can recipe format v1.3 express, and what exactly is missing from the rest?
why_it_is_a_security_measurement: The containment argument rests on transforms being a CLOSED ENUM rather than an expression language. Each shape the enum cannot express is pressure to add an escape hatch, and an escape hatch is where arbitrary computation -- and the injection surface -- comes back. Counting gaps is counting pressure on the boundary.
method: attempt a recipe using ONLY frozen format v1.3
execute it with Experiment L's executor
classify EXPRESSIBLE or GAP and NAME the missing capability
the format is NOT extended during M; a gap is recorded, never patched

S1_clean_wide.note: the shape the format was designed on

S2_stacked_header.note: a single header_row cannot name a two-row header ('2026' over 'Tammi'); needs multi-row header flattening

S3_two_measure_blocks.note: one unpivot per sheet; needs two, plus a way to say which columns belong to which measure

S5_formatted_numbers.note: type: number has no format declaration for thousands separators or percent; same family as L's gap G1. Judged a GAP before the run because the recipe cannot produce the correct table -- a downstream sum would fail

S6_interleaved_note.note: label_in needs the literal text in advance; an unforeseen note in the MIDDLE of the data is absorbed by remainder, and unlike K's C13 it is not at the bottom where a shape rule catches it. Predicted SILENT_WRONG: executes with a wrong extra row

decision_table.condition: a predicted GAP turns out expressible
a predicted EXPRESSIBLE turns out a gap
a shape executes to a WRONG TABLE while the recipe validates
decision_table.outcome: flag SILENT_WRONG separately -- the unsafe class, categorically worse than a refusal

hard_stop: No changes to the frozen grammar, format v1.3, L's executor, or any recorded result.
No capability is added to the format during M, however obvious the fix looks.
